title: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking Essentials
description: Protect applications against OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, understand network penetration testing, and implement public-key cryptography.
overview: Master offensive and defensive web security concepts, penetration testing methodologies, and cryptographic standards.
learningOutcomes: Identify and mitigate OWASP Top 10 web security flaws (XSS, SQLi, CSRF)
Perform network packet sniffing and security audits
Implement Public Key Encryption (RSA, AES-256) and JWT authentication
Audit API security endpoints and authorization headers

modules.title: Module 1: Web Application Security & OWASP Top 10

topics.title: Preventing Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) & SQL Injection
topics.summary: Learn sanitized query parameterization and Content Security Policies (CSP) to defend web servers.
cheatSheet: Never concatenate user input directly into SQL/NoSQL queries.
Use HttpOnly and SameSite flags for authentication cookies.
